Spec FR-001 requires ingestion of raw text transcripts; the plan only ingests pre‑computed sentence embeddings, omitting the raw transcripts required by the specification.
Spec mandates reporting effect sizes as Cohen's d, but the plan replaces this with rank‑biserial correlation, which does not satisfy the specified success criterion.

Spec requires extraction of lexical (TTR, MTLD, noun/verb ratio) and syntactic (mean clause length, T‑unit count) features; the plan omits these features due to missing raw text, leaving the specification unmet.
